Applications are invited for the position of Research Associate (RA-I, II or III) to work under the guidance of Prof. Ganesh Subramanian, Engineering Mechanics Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru 56006. The research, to be …

(1) Understanding swimmer migration-cum-dispersion in unsteady shearing flows with a focus on understanding the origin of oceanic thin phytoplankton layers.

(2) Examining the motion of active swimmers in complex spatially periodic and aperiodic shearing flows, with an emphasis on understanding dispersion in porous media.
